content: Now I have enough. Let me confirm the SSEHub is wired via HTTP/SSE endpoint (not websocket) by checking sse_hub.go briefly.

Confirmed — this is Server-Sent Events, not WebSocket (the gorilla/websocket dependency in go.mod is unrelated/indirect and not used by this hub).

q20. mechanism: Server-Sent Events (SSE) — a per-server in-memory hub of channel-based `SSEClient` subscribers, not WebSocket (despite `gorilla/websocket` being listed as an indirect dependency in `go.mod`, it isn't what powers this).

- hub path: `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go` — `SSEHub` struct (line 56) with `Subscribe`/`Unsubscribe`/`Broadcast`/`Close` methods; `Broadcast` (line 115) fans an `SSEEvent` out to all connected clients' buffered channels without blocking.

- memo handlers that broadcast through `s.SSEHub.Broadcast(...)`:
  - `CreateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:163` (emits `memo.created`, skipped when suppressed via `isSSESuppressed`)
  - `DeleteMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:585` (emits `memo.deleted`)
  - `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_update_helpers.go:71` (emits `memo.updated`; called from `UpdateMemo` at `memo_service.go:513`)
  - `CreateMemoComment` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:126` (emits `memo.comment.created` for the parent memo)
  - `UpsertMemoReaction` — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:106` (emits `reaction.upserted`)
  - `DeleteMemoReaction` — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:161` (emits `reaction.deleted`)
